title: Work of the restricted-weight construction
statement: The deterministic restricted-weight construction work assigned to an input is the sum of the deterministic small-bias construction work for its inner and outer generator inputs.
caveat: The provided definition of `RestrictedWeightInput` declares no inner or outer generator inputs, so the displayed definition cannot be interpreted from the supplied formal statement alone.
